title: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: 改革开放以来，中国人民生活水平不断提高，这在人们的饮食 (diet)变化上得到充分体现 。如今，人们不再满足于吃得饱，而是追求吃得更加安全、更加营养、更加健康，食物也愈来愈丰富多样，不再限于本地的农产品。物流业 (logistics industry)的发展使人们很容易品尝到全国各地的特产。毫无疑问，食品质量与饮食结构的改善为增进人们健康提供了有力的保障。
reference: Since the reform and opening-up, the living standards of the Chinese people have improved steadily, which is fully reflected in the changes in people's diet. Today, people are no longer content with simply having enough to eat; instead, they pursue food that is safer, more nutritious and healthier. Food is also becoming more and more diverse, no longer being limited to local agricultural products. The development of the logistics industry makes it easy for people to taste specialties from all over the country. Undoubtedly, the improvement in food quality and diet structure provides a strong guarantee for improving people's health.
